title: When the Hymn Wakes
author: Rosalind Sandoval
blurb: Ivo Lockridge, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
